links.comparator_used: Foundational LLMs (ChatGPT, LLaMA, Gemini) at baseline, before iterative improvement
links.outcome: Agreement with physician panel consensus (Cohen κ)
links.effect: Baseline slight to fair agreement rose to substantial or higher (Cohen κ 0.73-0.82); improvement significant (P=.006 ChatGPT, P<.001 Gemini, P<.001 LLaMA)
links.quote: With iterative improvement techniques, this agreement evolved to be substantial or higher (Cohen κ of 0.73-0.82).

design_hint: iterative prompt improvement to align LLM outputs with physician consensus
